checks.basis: Five named architectures, two tasks, seed881101 and B1/16/32 are fixed before timing; no outcome-based arm selection.
checks.name: fixed_checkpoint_panel

checks.basis: External INDEX SHA binds shard hashes/counts and each required protocol/lock/checkpoint/selection/RESULT/validation member hash+size before hardware registration.
checks.name: externally_pinned_archive_members

checks.basis: Exact source map/full design/study seal/protocol SHA/preflight checked. Immutable hardware registration pins input bytes, rechecked before run.
checks.name: registered_source_and_data

checks.basis: Stored validation argmin and LR lock are verified against archived trusted records. RESULT metadata are read; no heldout arrays are loaded and no heldout metric chooses a case.
checks.name: checkpoint_selection_scope

checks.basis: Every call omits state and performs a full sequence, including all within-sequence model state, reset and refractory updates; no operator or output is cached across calls.
checks.name: complete_fresh_state_forward

checks.basis: Each exact selected checkpoint is loaded on CPU and produces a reference before device transfer. Both resident and host-copy outputs must match registered FP32 tolerances.
checks.name: cpu_reference

checks.basis: Device synchronization before/after every timed sample and start/end events on current stream; event time described as stream elapsed, including possible launch gaps.
checks.name: cuda_timing

checks.basis: Fresh input/dt device copies and output CPU copy included; model/disk setup separate. CPU executes equivalent fresh allocations.
checks.name: host_end_to_end_scope

checks.basis: The resident invoke closure is called by measure_energy inside torch.inference_mode, preserving the declared inference contract.
checks.name: energy_inference_mode

checks.basis: NVML handle resolved by full GPU UUID and returned UUID compared to the PyTorch device; unknown/MIG/mismatch yields null.
checks.name: exact_uuid

checks.basis: Only cumulative NVML millijoule differences become joules. Device-wide gross energy includes idle/background; no process/CPU/server energy claim or idle subtraction.
checks.name: actual_counter_units_and_scope

checks.basis: Regressions inside either idle interval and between all intervals invalidate active joules and normalized values; zero idle increment allowed, unresolved active increment null.
checks.name: monotone_counter_repair

checks.basis: Registered minimum active duration and maximum iteration count; too-short windows yield null rather than extrapolated energy.
checks.name: bounded_energy_window

checks.basis: Body clocks explicitly exclude imports/integrity checks. External whole-process wait4 remains required; setup/inference/energy clocks are nested.
checks.name: cost_scope

checks.basis: Unavailable CUDA is recorded unavailable, actual CUDA errors failed. complete is execution integrity, not evidence of GPU execution or superiority.
checks.name: unavailable_hardware

finding.initial_problem: Idle-before counter regression could coexist with a published positive active-window energy because only active and cross-window monotonicity were checked.
finding.resolution: Both idle windows now receive explicit internal-regression checks; exception clears all derived joule fields; exact fake sequence included in synthetic preflight.

remaining_external_evidence: Actual CUDA synchronization/event behavior on available hardware
Independent process exclusivity or whole-system energy if later claimed
scope: Read-only source review. Reviewer did not execute CUDA, NVML energy, or formal checkpoint measurements. Owner-provided synthetic receipt independently hash-bound.

synthetic_preflight.scope: Synthetic CPU inputs and untrained synthetic checkpoint fixture only. No formal checkpoint, validation/test arrays, CUDA timing or real energy counter is claimed.
